counterparty.name: Alibaba Group (阿里巴巴集团)
counterparty.description: Chinese e-commerce and cloud conglomerate. C-round (2025-06) investor in Unitree via wholly-owned Hangzhou Haoyue (1.6343M shares); affiliate Ant Group via Shanghai Yunchang (0.8172M shares).
